europe_now.title: French Protests and Curfews
europe_now.summary: French authorities implemented strict curfews and banned protests in major cities like Paris, Lyon, and Marseille following severe civil unrest and looting. The ongoing demonstrations have significantly impacted public security and prompted heightened security measures across the country.

sources.headline: Curfew imposed in certain areas of Paris every night until Monday morning
Paris extends curfew as Marseille and Lyon ban protests after riots

europe_now.title: Ukraine Conflict Developments
europe_now.summary: Ukraine experienced intensified missile and drone strikes following recent diplomatic engagements and visits by international envoys to the Kremlin. President Zelenskyy stated that these attacks demonstrate no shift in Russia's military objectives despite ongoing peace discussions.

sources.headline: Ukraine hit by strikes after Russia agrees to new peace talks
‘No change’ in Russia’s attitude on war shown by deadly attacks, Zelensky says

top_stories.title: International Criminal Court Receives EU Rights Prize
top_stories.summary: The International Criminal Court was awarded a top European Union human rights prize amid ongoing international scrutiny and pressure from the United States. The recognition highlights the institution's role in global accountability and justice.

sources.headline: Targeted by Trump, International Criminal Court wins top EU rights prize

top_stories.title: Italian Trucker Protests Impact Supply Chains
top_stories.summary: Transport blockades by truck drivers in southern Italy have severely disrupted regional supply chains, halting specific agricultural production lines. These demonstrations are placing mounting political and economic pressure on the national government.
